answer: Trust grows like a vine: each epoch, rewards flow only along 6-step random walks started from 20 audited seed agents, so an agent earns at most the walk mass that reaches it. A sybil swarm is a reef behind a narrow channel: 1,000 fake keys joined to the honest graph by 2 edges still share only what those 2 edges carry, so 100x more keys yields ~1x the reward. Weakness: buying edges from honest agents. Fix: glacier-slow vouches that gain weight over 30 epochs and are forfeited if the vouchee is slashed.
